exportTab.title: Export
exportTab.description: Pick a scope, filter what's included, choose a format, optionally encrypt — then haul aboard. JSON keeps full fidelity; other formats carry the filtered voyage list only.

details.intro: Label voyages with free-form text tags and a curated palette of color tags so ye can slice the sidebar by purpose (production, staging, customer-X, on-call rotation) instead of relying on chest structure alone.
details.usage: Text tags are free-form strings stored on each voyage; they appear in the voyage editor and feed the sidebar filter chips. Color tags are a shared palette saved with the database — assign one per voyage to tint its tab and tree-row dot, and use the filter chips above the voyage list to scope by color. Use the Assign action to apply a tag to many voyages at once; renames and deletes here refit every voyage that referenced the tag.
